name: website-bisnis
description: Repositori ini hanya memuat **dua folder utama**: `frontend/` (Astro) dan `backend/` (Go + PocketBase). Seluruh kode Next.js/Drizzle lama sudah dihapus.

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "fe,be" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.dev:fe: node scripts/infisical-env.mjs npm --prefix frontend run dev
scripts.build: node scripts/infisical-env.mjs npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.preview: node scripts/infisical-env.mjs npm --prefix frontend run preview
